competition.description: 3D time-lapse microscopy cell detection, lineage linking, and division reconstruction.
competition.prediction_target: A cell graph with detections, temporal links, and division events; metric is adjusted edge Jaccard with a division component.
competition.models: DoG/Hungarian; U-Net + transformer + ILP; association MLP ranker; harmonic fusion; edge-stage TTA; an independent three-classical-model heatmap ensemble; controlled post-processing.
competition.standing: Ongoing; best public 0.917 (Exp203 classical three-model ensemble, 55626138); rank #228/2628 with bronze at ~top 263; four submissions pending; final private/rank not available
competition.lesson: The 0.915 learned-stack plateau was broken not by tuning it but by an independent classical three-model detector ensemble, repeating the earlier pattern where the 0.913 plateau fell to an adopted external component. Its ablations show the gain needs the whole combination: removing the graph patches costs 0.025, detection TTA 0.007, and the appearance link cost 0.003.

nodes.title: Exp203 classical three-model ensemble
nodes.summary: Independent pooled-volume 3D U-Net heatmaps (bright + two top-hat) averaged before peak detection, with physical NMS, velocity-aware Hungarian links, conservative gap repair and line fitting. Broke the 0.915 plateau; uses xiaoleilian public weights, not the pilkwang support pack.

nodes.title: Line-fit smoothing OFF (exp183 base)
nodes.summary: Disables the only stage that moves coordinates. The shipped 0.8 pull displaces 92.6% of nodes (median 0.575um, 8.94% beyond 2um) against a centroid cliff measured at sigma~2um.

nodes.title: Line-fit weight 0.4 (exp183 base)
nodes.summary: Interior point of the bracket; separates "smoothing is harmful" from "smoothing is tuned too strong". Needed the inherited strategy guard repointed after v1 errored.

nodes.title: Exp222 line-fit off on the 0.917 stack
nodes.summary: The same one-line change ported onto the classical frontier, where LINEFIT_WEIGHT is a plain constant. Built and held until the exp183 bracket scores.

nodes.title: Exp220 DeepCenter best.pt + safe-division veto
nodes.summary: Loads DeepCenter from best.pt (epoch 2, confirmed in the run log) instead of checkpoint_last.pt (epoch 500). Exp158 ran the same veto on the epoch-500 checkpoint and it rejected ALL divisions for 0.905; on best.pt it retains 244 of 311, so it now acts as a selective gate. The checkpoint, not the gate, caused that failure. Companion Exp221 (best.pt, veto off) came out byte-identical to Exp183, so the DeepCenter gap veto is inert on this stack and this run isolates the safe-division veto alone.
